name: Almost Dead
source:
A young man awakes after a very bad car accident to discover that his life is going to change forever. Follow along as his story unfolds.

[from [url=https://badmustard.itch.io/almost-dead]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一名年輕男子在一場極其嚴重的車禍後醒來，發現自己的人生從此將徹底改變。跟隨他的腳步，看這個故事如何展開。

［摘自[url=https://badmustard.itch.io/almost-dead]itch.io[/url]］
